Target one additional willing creature. Each target receives the same selected benefit

system.description:
ARCHIVIST ENCHANTMENT UTILITY
Archivist Specialist Spell
Cast 1 AP (verbal)
Range 30 feet
Targets 1 willing creature
Duration 1 minute

You recount a deed attributed to a saint, prophet, divine champion or other sacred exemplar, allowing the target to emulate one fragment of their excellence.
When casting the spell, choose one of the following:
Fortitude;
Reflex;
Will; or
one skill in which you possess at least 1 rank.
The target gains a +1-status bonus to the selected saving throw or skill for the duration.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: Select one additional eligible saving throw or skill.
+2 PP: Target one additional willing creature. Each target receives the same selected benefit.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10. Choose Fortitude, Reflex, Will or a skill you have a rank in: +1 status on it, chosen at the cast.
